advisory_items.message: During action in 'ABSBrakeSupervisor.increase' assigns 'k1' to the same constant value every cycle.

suggested_fix_hints.summary: The during block writes the same constant numeric value on every cycle, which often indicates initialization logic was placed in ``during`` instead of ``enter``.

recommended_actions.rationale: Move the assignment to ``enter`` if it should run once on state entry.
Use runtime state in the expression if the value should evolve each cycle.

do_not: Do not suppress the warning by adding a meaningless arithmetic no-op.

advisory_items.rationale: Downgraded because `slp` is NL-grounded as an external sensor/environment input; adding invented writes would be less faithful than leaving it read-only. Evidence: NL states continuous/plant/process dynamics are outside the discrete controller.
